For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
